items.reply: Changed to FP: the unawaited isChecked() assertion is unchanged from base; this PR only adds a FIXME acknowledging its existing defect. The enable endpoint persists twoFactorEnabled: true before the backup-codes screen appears, so Close refreshes the UI rather than enabling 2FA. The subsequent login step still exercises OTP authentication. The vacuous switch assertion therefore falls under the pre-existing-defect rule.
